product_metadata.title: YIYEA 100% Organic Viscose Bamboo Fitted Sheet with Pillowcase, Premium 400 Thread Count Cooling Fitted Sheet Queen Size, 16 Inch Deep Pocket, Silky, Soft, Breathable - Queen, Grey
features: 🌙【 COST-EFFECTIVE COOLING FITTED SHEET SET 】Contains 1 queen bed fitted sheet and 2 ultra-soft queen pillowcases, the queen fitted sheet measuring 60" x 80" with a 16" deep pocket that fits any mattresses 16 inches and under; affordable and comfortable.

🌙 【GENUINE 100% VISCOSE BAMBOO FITTED SHEET】 YIYEA bed fitted sheet is crafted from 100% viscose bamboo, it has been OEKO-TEX Standard 100 Certified and tested for over 100 harmful substances, ensuring that it is safe, healthy and environmentally friendly for your family.

🌙【ULTIMATE COOLING & BREATHABLE】 The viscose bamboo fabric of the fitted sheet has better thermal regulating, wick moisture, and is breathable, which can effectively balance body temperature and keep you cool and relaxed all night for all-season comfort.

🌙【PERFECT FIT 16 INCH DEEP POCKET】We use a microfiber splicing design on the side of the bamboo fitted sheet to make it more wrapping and perfectly fits any mattresses 16 inches and under, no matter how you twist or turn in bed, it will stay in place and giving you the perfect restful night’s sleep.

🌙【CARE INSTRUCTION】 Compared to traditional Rayon fitted sheet, the 100% viscose bamboo fitted sheet is more durable, soft, and comfortable; Simply throw them in the Machine, wash cold, gentle cycle, tumble dry low, and avoid using bleach.
